Apply now!
Castrol is a global leader in lubricants and part of the bp Group, one of the world’s largest energy companies. In India, Castrol is a publicly listed company, leading in the Automotive, Industrial, and Marine lubricant sectors. With iconic brands, relentless innovation, strong customer relationships, and a team of highly motivated employees, we have maintained our market leadership in India for over a century. Our robust manufacturing and distribution network in India helps us reach consumers through more than 135,000 outlets.
At Castrol, success knows no bounds. We offer a fast\-paced learning environment where you can develop your career, whether in specialized functions or on a general management track. Castrol India has a proud legacy of championing top talent for leadership roles, both locally and globally!
Role Overview:
The Head of India Tax is responsible for leading and overseeing all tax matters relating to Castrol's operations in India and Pakistan. The role acts as a senior tax leader, the principal holder of relationships with fiscal authorities and senior business leaders, and is accountable for ensuring effective tax governance, compliance and risk management across the organisation.
The Head of India Tax will have primary accountability for managing all tax audits, enquiries, investigations and disputes, whilst ensuring that tax compliance, governance, risk management and advisory support are delivered effectively through a combination of internal teams, outsourced providers, external advisers and joint venture support arrangements.
The role provides leadership and oversight across all taxes affecting the business, including Corporate Income Tax, Indirect Taxes, Employment Taxes and Transfer Pricing. Support is provided through a combination of internal resources, a service agreement with a joint venture partner (bp) and its third\-party service providers, support from Castrol CC and external advisers. The role holder retains overall accountability for the quality, integrity and effectiveness of all tax activities delivered through these arrangements.
The Head of India Tax will be a member of the Castrol Head of Tax Leadership Team and will actively contribute to the development and delivery of Castrol's tax strategy, governance framework, risk management approach and leadership agenda.
Role and Responsibility
Reporting to the Castrol Head of Tax, the Head of India Tax will be a key contributor to the delivery of Castrol's tax strategy and objectives, providing tax expertise across all aspects of the business and actively contributing to the Castrol Tax Leadership Team.
Business Partnering and Advisory
Provide tax advice and support to Castrol's commercial operations in India and Pakistan across all taxes.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with business leadership teams to understand commercial strategies and business objectives and provide tax support that enables informed decision\-making.
Provide practical and commercially focused tax advice on business initiatives, restructurings, supply chain changes, new business opportunities and strategic projects.
Work with internal customers and external advisers to identify solutions that appropriately balance business objectives, compliance requirements and tax risk management.
Monitor developments in tax legislation and policy and provide guidance on the impact of those developments on the business.
Support engagement with industry groups, government bodies and fiscal authorities on matters affecting the business.
Tax Risk Management, Governance and Compliance
Work with the Castrol Tax Leadership Team to identify, assess and manage tax risks in accordance with Castrol's governance framework and ethical principles.
Maintain oversight of all direct and indirect tax compliance activities performed by internal teams, external providers and joint venture partners.
Ensure the timely and accurate completion of tax filings, Corporate Income Tax compliance, transfer pricing documentation and all associated compliance obligations.
Oversee tax payment obligations, tax reporting requirements and compliance calendars across the jurisdictions within scope.
Manage the design, documentation and monitoring of tax compliance processes and controls, working closely with Finance teams and external service providers.
Oversee tax governance processes and ensure appropriate controls are in place to support compliance with local regulatory requirements.
Support forecasting and monitoring of cash taxes and, where required, provide oversight of tax accounting and reporting activities.
Ensure compliance with all applicable tax laws, regulations and filing obligations across the jurisdictions within scope.
Continuously review tax compliance arrangements to ensure they remain effective, efficient and aligned with business requirements.
Tax Authorities, Audits and Controversy Management
Act as the primary relationship holder with fiscal authorities across the jurisdictions within scope.
Develop and maintain constructive and professional relationships with tax authorities and relevant government bodies.
Lead the management of all tax audits, enquiries, investigations and disputes.
Coordinate responses to tax authority requests and ensure appropriate governance and documentation is maintained.
Work with tax authorities, government bodies and external advisers to resolve tax disputes and achieve appropriate technical and commercial outcomes.
Provide leadership and oversight in relation to significant tax risks, uncertain tax positions and tax controversy matters.
Tax Operations and Compliance Oversight
Oversee all tax activities delivered through outsourced providers, external advisers, joint venture support arrangements and Transitional Service Agreements.
Ensure roles, responsibilities and accountabilities are clearly defined between all parties involved in delivering tax activities.
Monitor service delivery arrangements to ensure compliance obligations are fulfilled accurately and on a timely basis.
Support the transition of tax activities from TSA\-supported arrangements to a sustainable long\-term compliance model.
Establish and maintain appropriate compliance monitoring and reporting processes.
Ensure robust documentation is maintained to support tax filings, tax positions, audit activity and governance requirements.
Work closely with Finance teams to ensure the quality and integrity of data used in support of tax compliance and reporting activities.
Promote consistency in tax governance, controls and compliance standards across all jurisdictions within scope.
Leadership and Culture
As a senior leader within Castrol, the Head of India Tax will be expected to inspire and empower others to achieve organisational objectives while actively supporting the culture, values and strategic ambitions of the organisation.
Directly manage, mentor and develop a high\-performing team of tax professionals, promoting a culture of excellence, inclusion and professional growth.
Provide leadership and oversight to tax resources located within India and support the management of tax activities relating to Pakistan.
Essential Experience and Qualifications
Educated to degree level with a relevant professional tax, accounting or legal qualification.
Extensive tax planning, advisory, compliance and risk management experience within a global or multinational environment.
Strong knowledge of Indian tax legislation and practice, including Corporate Income Tax, GST, Employment Taxes and Transfer Pricing.
Awareness of tax requirements affecting Pakistan and the ability to oversee compliance obligations through internal resources, external advisers and service providers.
Significant experience managing tax authorities, audits, enquiries, disputes and regulatory interactions.
Demonstrated experience of providing practical, commercially focused tax advice to senior business partners.
Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organisation.
Experience managing external advisers, outsourced service providers and multi\-party delivery models.
Significant experience managing complex tax compliance and governance activities within a multinational environment.
Strong understanding of tax governance, internal controls and compliance frameworks.
Experience establishing and operating tax compliance processes and control frameworks across multiple jurisdictions.
Experience managing tax accounting, cash tax and tax reporting requirements.
Adaptability and resilience, with a willingness to lead and support change where appropriate.
Proven ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams and build productive relationships across Finance, Legal, HR, Commercial and Operational functions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate complex tax concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
Desirable Experience and Qualifications
Experience within the consumer products, manufacturing or other complex multinational sectors.
Experience supporting business separations, joint ventures, mergers, acquisitions or large\-scale organisational change programmes.
Experience handling Transitional Service Agreements and transitioning tax activities into standalone operating models.
Experience managing tax activities across more than one jurisdiction, including through outsourced providers and external advisers.
Familiarity with OECD tax developments and international taxation matters affecting multinational groups.
You will work with :
Outside of the wider Castrol Tax function, the Head of India Tax will develop and maintain strong working relationships with a broad range of internal and external customers to support compliance, governance, risk management and business decision\-making across India and Pakistan.
Key External Stakeholders
Fiscal authorities and government bodies.
External tax advisers and compliance service providers.
Joint venture partner tax and finance teams.
Government and regulatory authorities across jurisdictions within scope.

Castrol Head of Tax.
Castrol Tax Leadership Team.
India Country Leadership Team.
Regional and global leadership teams relevant to India and Pakistan operations.
Business leaders across India and Pakistan operations.
Finance leadership and key Finance interfaces, particularly where tax data, reporting inputs and financial information are required.
Local Finance and Accounting teams.
Legal, Treasury, Human Resources, Company Secretariat, Risk and Compliance functions.
Internal Audit and Controls teams.
Shared service and business support teams involved in tax compliance and reporting activities.

We support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and exciting environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity. We are committed to crafting an inclusive environment in which everyone is respected and treated fairly.
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

description:
**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The People Team at Agoda is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional talent from across the globe. We work to create an inclusive, high\-performing, and engaging environment where employees can grow, contribute meaningfully, and do their best work. Through a strong focus on people experience, service quality, and business partnership, we help Agoda scale while preserving what makes our culture distinctive.
   

  

 Within the People Team, the
 **People Experience and Services** 
 function is responsible for designing and delivering critical people experiences, services, and operating foundations that support employees and managers across the employee lifecycle. This includes enabling smooth onboarding and mobility experiences, delivering effective workplace and office services, and ensuring employees have access to timely, trusted, and high\-quality support when they need it.
   

  

 At the center of this model sits
 **People Services \& Help Desk** 
 — Agoda’s front door for People support — supported by specialist service teams such as
 **People Relations Services** 
 . Together, these teams play a critical role in how employees and managers experience the People function day to day: through clear guidance, responsive support, effective issue resolution, and trusted handling of sensitive people matters.
   

  

**Opportunity**
 We are looking for an
 **Associate Director, Head of People Services \& Help Desk** 
 to lead Agoda’s employee\-facing People service delivery model across
 **People Help Desk / Tier 1 support** 
 ,
 **Tier 0 / self\-service foundations** 
 , and
 **Global People Relations Services** 
 .
   

  

 This is a key leadership role within People Experience and Services, responsible for shaping how employees and managers access support across a wide range of People topics — from day\-to\-day HR questions and lifecycle support to more complex and sensitive employee matters requiring specialist intervention.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead the teams responsible for:
   

  

* People Help Desk / Tier 1 services
* Tier 0 / self\-service and knowledge foundations
* Global People Relations Services, including case governance and specialist support for complex employee relations matters


 You will own the effectiveness of Agoda’s People support model from the employee and manager perspective, ensuring it is clear, trusted, scalable, and increasingly insight\-driven. This includes strengthening service standards, improving routing and handoffs across teams, enabling greater self\-service, and ensuring sensitive employee matters are handled with appropriate quality, consistency, and governance.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a leader who combines strong service delivery and operational leadership with sound judgment, systems thinking, and the ability to build a modern, scalable People support model in a global, fast\-moving organization.
   

  

 This position is based in
 **Bangkok** 
 . Agoda provides relocation support for successful candidates who are not currently located in Bangkok. Please note that we are
 **not open to remote work** 
 or the possibility of being based in other locations.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Lead Agoda’s People Services front door and employee support model**
* Lead Agoda’s employee\-facing People Services model across Tier 1 Help Desk support, Tier 0 self\-service, and the interface into specialist support teams.
* Define and evolve how employees and managers access support across People topics, ensuring a clear, seamless, and trusted experience.
* Establish strong service principles, operating rhythms, and leadership across the teams responsible for day\-to\-day People support and complex employee issue resolution.
* Ensure Agoda’s People support model scales effectively with organizational growth, complexity, and global reach.


**Lead the People Services \& Help Desk team**
* Lead, manage, and develop the People Services \& Help Desk team to deliver high\-quality, consistent, and empathetic Tier 1 support across core HR topics such as policies, processes, employee data, benefits, onboarding, leaves, mobility, and general employee lifecycle support.
* Set service standards, KPIs, quality expectations, and operating controls to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant case handling.
* Build a strong service culture with clear accountability for employee experience, right\-first\-time resolution, responsiveness, and professionalism.
* Oversee workforce planning, capacity management, and prioritization across service demand, seasonal peaks, and new People initiatives.


**Lead Global People Relations Services**
* Lead the Global People Relations Services team, ensuring high\-quality and well\-governed support across complex employee matters such as performance concerns, misconduct, grievances, investigations, disciplinary actions, involuntary exits, and employee matters arising from organizational change.
* Ensure clear service ownership, escalation pathways, and governance across People Relations case handling.
* Partner closely with HR Business Partners, Legal, Compliance, and other relevant stakeholders to ensure people relations matters are handled fairly, consistently, pragmatically, and in line with internal policies and local legal requirements.
* Drive high standards in case management, documentation, risk identification, and decision quality across the People Relations team.
* Use case trends and themes to inform improvements in manager guidance, policy design, service processes, and broader practices.


**Own the operating interfaces across Tier 1, People Relations, and specialist teams**
* Serve as the senior operational owner for how work flows between Help Desk / Tier 1, People Relations Services, and other Tier 2 / specialist teams across the People organization.
* Define and continuously improve routing logic, escalation models, intake criteria, handoffs, service ownership, and resolution pathways.
* Ensure employees and managers experience a joined\-up service model even when multiple People teams are involved.
* Clarify roles and interfaces across Help Desk, People Relations, Payroll, Rewards, Mobility, People Partners, CoEs, and other specialist teams.


**Build Tier 0 / self\-service and knowledge management foundations**
* Develop and execute Agoda’s roadmap for Tier 0 / self\-service, moving the organization toward more proactive, intuitive, and self\-directed resolution of common People queries.
* Own and strengthen the People knowledge ecosystem, including FAQs, help content, decision trees, agent guidance, and employee\-facing support materials.
* Partner with policy owners and People SMEs to simplify complex topics into clear, scalable, and user\-friendly content.
* Drive case deflection, knowledge reuse, content governance, and self\-service adoption through disciplined measurement and continuous improvement.


**Enable digital, conversational, and AI\-supported service delivery**
* Partner with Product, Tech, Systems, and Data teams to improve People support platforms, workflows, and user journeys across self\-service and case management.
* Identify and help shape practical use cases for conversational and agentic AI within People Services, ensuring they enhance employee experience and complement human support.
* Provide leadership input into the design, testing, rollout, and continuous refinement of AI\-enabled and digital service solutions.
* Ensure appropriate controls, privacy, escalation paths, and trust mechanisms are in place for all digital and AI\-supported support channels.


**Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement**
* Monitor and improve key service performance metrics across Help Desk and People Relations Services, such as case volume, first contact resolution, time to resolution, service quality, customer satisfaction, escalation rates, re\-open rates, and self\-service deflection.
* Lead ongoing improvements in workflows, playbooks, standard responses, training, quality assurance, and reporting.
* Partner with People Service Excellence and other stakeholders to simplify processes, remove friction, and improve end\-to\-end employee and manager experiences.
* Ensure effective controls, compliance, documentation standards, and data privacy practices are embedded across service operations.


**Lead through insight, stakeholder partnership, and change**
* Act as the senior People Services contact for service performance, priorities, risks, and transformation opportunities.
* Provide regular insight and reporting to People leaders on service trends, root causes, organizational pain points, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with Communications and relevant People teams to coordinate messaging around policy changes, process updates, and new tools or services.
* Support broader People transformation by bringing an employee\-service lens to operating model design, simplification, and capability building across the function.


**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Human Resources, Operations, Law, Psychology, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.
* Typically, 10\+ years of relevant experience across HR shared services, employee services, People operations, employee relations, HRBP, service delivery, or related functions, including significant leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading managers and/or multiple service teams in a complex, matrixed, and fast\-paced environment.
* Strong experience running a service or support function with clear accountability for quality, responsiveness, service design, and stakeholder experience.
* Strong understanding of multi\-tier service delivery models, including Tier 0 / self\-service, Tier 1 support, and specialist / Tier 2 case management.
* Meaningful exposure to employee relations or complex people issue resolution, with sound judgment on sensitive matters and a strong appreciation for governance, risk, and consistency.
* Strong skills in service design, operating model improvement, process improvement, and cross\-functional workflow design.
* Experience with HR technology platforms and service tools such as HRIS, case management systems, knowledge bases, and digital support tools.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and analytics to monitor performance, identify themes and root causes, and drive prioritization and decision\-making.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and influence across leaders, specialist teams, and cross\-functional partners.
* Strong people leadership capability, including coaching leaders and managers, building team capability, and creating a high\-performance, service\-oriented culture.
* Comfort operating in a global, evolving, and ambiguous environment, with a strong bias for execution, improvement, and scale.


**It’s great if you also have**
* Experience in a global or regional HR shared services / People services environment.
* Experience leading both broad employee support teams and specialist employee relations or case management teams.
* Experience in knowledge management, service content strategy, and self\-service adoption.
* Hands\-on exposure to conversational AI, chatbots, virtual assistants, or workflow automation in HR or customer support environments.
* Experience improving employee experience through service redesign, process simplification, or digital product thinking.
* Experience in a high\-growth tech, internet, or digital business.
* Familiarity with global organizations operating across multiple countries, cultures, and regulatory environments.


**Why this role matters**
 This role is a unique opportunity to shape how Agoda employees and managers experience People support at scale. From everyday HR queries to more complex and sensitive employee matters, the teams in this scope play an important role in making sure our people feel supported, informed, and able to navigate key moments in their Agoda journey with confidence.
   

  

 As
 **Associate Director, Head of People Services \& Help Desk** 
 , you will help build a more connected, scalable, and future\-ready support model, improving service quality, strengthening self\-service, and ensuring complex cases are handled with care and consistency. Your work will directly influence employee experience, manager effectiveness, and how the People function continues to evolve as Agoda grows globally.

description:
**This is where** 
 your work makes a difference.
   

  

 At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.
   

  

 Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

 The future of HR Operations is being redefined at Baxter. Across the company, HR is unlocking new ways to deliver value — not just through processes, but through experiences that empower people and build confidence. This is a moment of transformation, and HR Operations is at the center of it.
   

  

 We are shaping a world‑class HR Operations organization that blends scale, precision, and innovation. By harnessing technology and process excellence, we are creating solutions that strengthen compliance, accelerate change, and elevate the employee journey. Joining Baxter means stepping into a role where your expertise will influence how HR operates globally and helps define what great looks like.
   

  

**Your Role in the Transformation**
 As a Team Leader in HR Operations GBS, you will lead a team that delivers accurate, consistent, and trusted HR services across regions. You’ll oversee operations, guide transitions, and ensure compliance while driving improvements that elevate the employee experience. This role places you at the center of Baxter’s transformation, where your leadership will empower people, strengthen processes, and set new standards for operational excellence.
   

  

**What You’ll Drive And Deliver**
* Supervise a team of 12–15 transaction processors in HR Operations.
* Manage end‑to‑end Pre‑Payroll and HR Operations functions with deep domain knowledge.
* Apply ERP expertise (SAP, Oracle, HR Web, ServiceNow, Workday) to streamline workflows.
* Lead migration of HR processes into GBS, ensuring smooth transitions.
* Safeguard data integrity across HR systems, reinforcing Baxter’s reputation for reliability.
* Maintain monthly dashboards including KPIs, balanced scorecards, and performance metrics.
* Ensure quality parameters and SLAs are consistently met.
* Identify gaps, propose solutions, and implement changes to mitigate risks.
* Collaborate with HRBPs, COEs, and business stakeholders to strengthen delivery.
* Drive performance improvement and foster positive change in people management.
* Monitor accuracy of transaction processing and quality of data.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Excellent communication skills in English, written and verbal.
* Experience in HR Operations or Shared Services with exposure to multi‑country environments.
* Transition management expertise (Americas/EMEA experience required).
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or similar process improvement methodologies.
* Ability to manage audits, controls, and governance frameworks.
* Strong stakeholder management across geographies and functions.
* High attention to detail with focus on accuracy and compliance.
* Proven people management experience (3\+ years).
* Ability to coach and develop people.
* Hands‑on Workday experience.
* Flexibility to work in rotational shifts (Europe \& Americas).


**Your Background**
* Graduate in any discipline (MBA in HR is a plus).
* Green Belt Six Sigma certification preferred.
* 10–13 years of experience in HR Operations or Shared Services, including 3\+ years in people management.


**Work Schedule**
 This position operates on rotational shifts across regions. Working hours will vary depending on shift schedules, requiring adaptability to support operations seamlessly across Europe and the Americas.
   

  

 This role is more than a position in HR Operations — it is a chance to be part of Baxter’s global transformation. As we redefine how HR delivers value, your leadership will shape processes, strengthen compliance, and elevate employee experience across regions. The work you do here will not only drive operational excellence but also set new benchmarks for what great looks like in HR. At Baxter, you will grow, influence, and leave a lasting mark on the future of our people and our business.

title: Associate I,TOC Engineer-Technology Infrastructure - Intern
description:
Job Overview
  
  

**Job Description:** TOC Engineer Role
  
We are seeking a highly motivated and software\-driven Associate TOC Engineer (AI \& Automation ) \- Intern to help build our next\-generation AI Operations (AIOps) solutions. This is a pure development role designed for an ambitious fresher looking to bridge the gap between software engineering, data science, and smart automation.
  
You will develop cutting\-edge, AI\-powered applications and predictive models using Python, engineer high\-throughput data pipelines in Google BigQuery, and build smart automation systems driven by Google Gemini to revolutionize technical operations. If you love coding, training baseline ML models, experimenting with LLMs, and building interactive internal tools, this role is for you.
  
Key Responsibilities (Pure Development)
  
* AIOps \& Smart Automation: Learn to architect and write code for autonomous self\-healing scripts, anomaly detection pipelines, and predictive alerting systems using machine learning libraries.
* Predictive Modeling: Build and evaluate baseline machine learning/prediction models to forecast system behavior, track metrics, and identify anomalies.
* AI Application Development: Assist in developing intelligent automation tools and internal applications that integrate with Google Gemini or other foundational LLMs.
* Full\-Stack \& Interactive Tooling: Build and maintain robust backend tools and fast, type\-safe APIs using Python, Django, and Django Ninja. Develop interactive front\-end dashboards and internal analytics tools using Streamlit, React basics, and Jinja templates.
* Data Layer Engineering: \* Write and optimize analytical data pipelines within Google BigQuery to process log files, metrics, and system events at scale.
* Manipulate, clean, and structure operational datasets efficiently using Pandas and NumPy.
* Implement SQLite systems for application\-level caching, local configurations, and rapid prototyping of state\-management tools.
* Linux Infrastructure Automation: Code automated deployment scripts, daemon processes, and system management tools tailored for Linux environments.


Technical Skills \& Qualifications
  
1\. Data Science \& Predictive ML Frameworks
  
* Machine Learning: Basic conceptual knowledge and hands\-on academic or project experience building prediction models with scikit\-learn.
* Data Manipulation: Good understanding of data analysis, matrix processing, and data structures using Pandas and NumPy.
* Rapid Prototyping: Experience creating clean, data\-driven web applications or dashboards using Streamlit.


2\. AI \& GenAI Basics
  
* Foundational understanding of integrating LLMs (Google Gemini good to have) into applications through academic/personal projects, APIs, or hackathons.
* Curiosity and awareness of Agentic AI workflows (how LLMs can use external tools or execute basic loops).


3\. Software Engineering \& Web Development
  
* Python Basics \& Beyond: Strong command of Python fundamentals (Data types, Loops, Object\-Oriented Programming, and writing clean, structured code).
* Web Frameworks \& APIs: Solid understanding of building applications with Django (Models, Views, ORM basics) and designing modern APIs using Ninja (or similar Pydantic\-based frameworks).
* Frontend Basics: Basic competency in React (state, hooks, components) and Jinja templating for fast, interactive web layout rendering.


4\. Data \& Core Systems
  
* BigQuery \& SQL: Solid SQL capability to model, query, and manipulate data sets within cloud data warehouses like Google BigQuery.
* SQLite \& DB Fundamentals: Strong understanding of relational database basics, including indexing, structured schemas, and lightweight transactional storage via SQLite.
* Linux Environment: Command\-line fluency; ability to navigate filesystems and write basic bash scripts natively in Linux.


Preferred / Good to Have Qualifications
  
* Basic exposure to RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) frameworks or vector databases is a major plus.
* Any exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) tools like Vertex AI or Cloud Run.
* B.Tech or equivalent degree
* 0\-1 years of experience


**Our Benefits:** Global vision, local impact
  
  

* At OSTTRA, our benefits philosophy offers a market\-competitive package that reflects our position as an industry leader. We want to ensure you feel valued, secure, and empowered wherever you are in the world.
* Our approach is built on three core pillars:
* Global foundations: We provide a baseline of excellence across all our offices, focusing on comprehensive Health \& Wellness, Financial Security, and Work\-Life Balance. No matter your location, you are part of a culture that prioritizes your holistic well\-being.
* Locally tailored: We benchmark in each market to ensure our packages are genuinely competitive where you live and work.
* Flexibility and growth: We empower you to work in a way that suits your life. This includes a hybrid working model, generous leave policies, and a commitment to your continuous professional development.


The Trust employee ownership plan
  
  

Every employee at OSTTRA is an owner, and a member of The Trust, our employee ownership programme. Our distinct culture encourages colleagues to think and act like owners and raise the bar constantly. This plan reflects our belief that when we work together to build a stronger, more valuable organisation, then all colleagues should benefit from the value we create.
  
  

About OSTTRA
  
  

We build and operate the infrastructure that the world’s post\-trade financial system runs on. Launched in 2021, we have unified more than 20 years of heritage and expertise from four industry leaders into a single, integrated business.
  
  

Today,we operate a trusted network that connects thousands of market participants to streamline end\-to\-end workflows, from trade capture through portfolio optimisation.We translate industry change into workable process, engineering an open, intelligent ecosystem that removes friction and reduces risk for the global markets.
  
  

Our distinct ownership culture is underpinned by four behaviours: boldness, curiosity, accountability, and collaboration. In 2025 we were acquired by KKR, one of the world’s most successful private equity firms, and are on a journey of growth and impact.
  
  

Joining our team now is a unique opportunity \- you will help to shape the next generation of post\-trade, transform shared infrastructure into shared benefit, and accelerate your own career. Learn more atwww.osttra.com.
  
  

Equal opportunity employer statement at OSTTRA
  
  

We are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all colleagues have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasise fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain the best talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive and operate the infrastructure that the world’s post\-trade financial system runs on

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.

Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Ops Staff** is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Shipment Processing \& Operations**

* Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.

* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.

**Data Entry \& Operational Documentation**

**Operational Support**

* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.

**Safety, Security \& Compliance**

* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement**

* Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of experience in logistics, warehousing, courier, manufacturing, retail operations or similar operational environments.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.

**About Satyam Technocrats**

Satyam Technocrats is an industrial automation company specializing in Line Automation, End\-of\-Line Packaging, Industrial Robotics, PLC\-Based Control Systems, and Machine Building Solutions. We design and manufacture customized automation systems that help industries improve productivity, quality, and operational efficiency.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a motivated Electrical Design Engineer to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate will assist in designing electrical control panels, preparing electrical schematics, selecting components, and supporting automation projects from design through commissioning.

Component Selection

Documentation

* Prepare electrical documentation, panel drawings, and project documentation.

* Support preparation of operation manuals and technical documentation.

Project Support

* Coordinate with Mechanical Design, PLC Programming, and Production teams.
* Assist during panel assembly, testing, and commissioning.
* Resolve design\-related issues during manufacturing and installation.

**Required Skills**

* Basic knowledge of electrical control systems.
* Ability to read and prepare electrical drawings.
* Understanding of industrial electrical components.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail.

**Preferred Technical Knowledge**

* AutoCAD Electrical / EPLAN (preferred)
* PLC hardware fundamentals
* Electrical Panels \& Control Circuits
* Motor Starters \& Protection Devices
* VFD Basics
* Industrial Sensors \& Field Devices
* Electrical Safety Standards

**Qualifications**

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, or related field.
* **0–2 years** of experience in Electrical Design, Panel Design, or Industrial Automation.
* Freshers with strong academic knowledge and CAD skills are encouraged to apply.

**Why Join Satyam Technocrats?**

* Work on real\-world industrial automation and machine\-building projects.
* Gain hands\-on experience in electrical design, panel engineering, and automation systems.
* Learn from experienced engineers in a collaborative work environment.
* Excellent opportunities for technical growth and career advancement.

title: Electrical & Electronics Technician
description:
**Company Overview**

One of India's leading waste management companies, specialized in the structured and compliant channelization of electronic, battery, and plastic waste. We work with leading household brands and corporate giants to recover valuable resources and manage electronic waste responsibly. We are looking for skilled, hands\-on Electrical \& Electronics Technicians to join our operations and Material Recovery Facility (MRF).

**Job Summary**

The Electrical \& Electronics Technician will be responsible for inspecting, testing, diagnosing, dismantling, and sorting various household and commercial electronic appliances. This role requires technical expertise to safely handle diverse electronic items, identify functional parts, and ensure that dismantling processes align with waste management and safety guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Testing \& Diagnostics:** Safely test and diagnose incoming electronic waste (including home appliances, commercial coolers, IT equipment, and consumer electronics) to identify salvageable or reusable components.
* **Safe Dismantling:** Disassemble complex electronic products, printed circuit boards (PCBs), and electrical machinery using hand and power tools without damaging recyclable elements.
* **Component Segregation:** Systematically sort recovered components (e.g., capacitors, copper wiring, motors, compressors, and plastics) based on material types and hazardous classifications.
* **Technical Assistance:** Assist in handling commercial cooling systems (like visi\-coolers), identifying refrigeration or electrical system defaults.
* **EHS Compliance:** Maintain a clean, organized, and hazard\-free workspace. Strictly adhere to Environment, Health \& Safety (EHS) guidelines, pollution control board norms, and consistently use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
* **Inventory Logging:** Report daily dismantling and testing outcomes to the Warehouse/Operations Manager.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Education:** ITI / Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related technical trade.
* **Experience:** 1 to 3 years of experience in repairing, dismantling, or testing consumer electronics, home appliances, or electrical assemblies (Freshers with strong practical ITI training are also welcome to apply).
* **Technical Skills:**
* Sound knowledge of electrical circuitry, wiring, and electronic components.
* Proficiency in using testing instruments (multimeters, soldering irons, testers) and hand/power tools.
* Ability to safely handle hazardous elements like batteries or electrical capacitors.
* **Soft Skills:** Detail\-oriented, disciplined, and a strong team player with a commitment to environmental safety.

description:
**Company Description**

We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities.

 Do what you love, care for the world, dare to challenge the status quo! \#BELIMITLESS"
   

  

**Job Description**
**Summary of Responsibilities:** 
 Reporting to the General Manager \& Regional People \& Culture Head, responsibilities and essential job functions include but are not limited to the following:
   

  

* Lead end‑to‑end recruitment and hiring processes, including job postings, applicant tracking (HERO), candidate follow‑up, job offers, background checks, compliance, and onboarding administration.

* Partner with Finance, Payroll, and leadership teams on annual performance reviews, wage adjustments, merit increases, market surveys, and salary benchmarking.
* Ensure full compliance with employment laws and policies, including employee relations matters, investigations, progressive discipline, terminations, unemployment claims, and ethics hotline concerns.
* Oversee workers’ compensation, compliances, leave administration etc
* Oversee employee benefits administration, including open enrollment, benefit system enrollment, and ensuring colleague understanding of available benefits.
* Design, and/or roll out, and facilitate leadership development, diversity \& inclusion, discrimination \& harassment, and compliance training programs.
* Support colleague engagement, wellness initiatives, recognition programs, and cultural events while promoting positive employee relations and open communication.
* Assist General Manager in daily department operations, strategic HR initiatives, and cross‑functional projects, serving as a compliance backup as needed.


**Qualifications**
* Knowledge and Experience

* Competencies
* Strong leadership, interpersonal and negotiation skills

* A team player \& builder

 Additional Information
   

  

 "Diversity \& Inclusion for Accor means welcoming each and everyone and respecting their differences by giving priority only to qualities and skills in extending employment and development opportunities.
   

  

 Our ambition is to provide meaningful employment, a warm and welcoming culture, excellent working conditions and to promote the development of all people, including those with disabilities.
   

  

 Do not hesitate to let us know of any specific needs you may have so that we can take them into consideration."

title: Resource Manager (Editorial & Creative Teams)
description:
**Company Description**
 At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next\-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start\-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
   

  

 Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self\-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
   

  

**Job Description**
 EVERSANA Intouch is looking for a Resource Manager who will bring problem solving, positive energy and collaboration to our Resource Management team. You will work as a partner with various teams, helping ensure that all projects get assigned on time while balancing workloads across the team. Be prepared to stay on your toes as you solve for real\-time resourcing requests while proactively planning for what lies ahead, looking at both the big picture and the small details. You should be comfortable asking questions and expressing your best possible solution for teams who need resourcing support. You should understand the importance of leveraging resourcing\-related data and tools while balancing that with what’s happening at the ground level. Agency project management and resource management experience are both relevant backgrounds in this role. Strong communication skills are necessary as well. This role in particular will primarily be responsible for resourcing for our Editorial team.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Bring problem\-solving skills, positive energy, and collaboration to the Resource Management team.
* Partner with various teams to ensure timely project assignments and balanced workloads.
* Address real\-time resourcing requests while proactively planning for future needs.
* Maintain a balance between big\-picture planning and attention to small details.
* Communicate effectively to provide the best possible resourcing solutions.
* Leverage resourcing\-related data and tools to support decision\-making.
* Understand and respond to ground\-level resourcing needs.
* Primarily manage resourcing for the Editorial team.
* Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
* Maintain and update employee data records for all full\-time employees, contractors, and freelancers in our core systems (Workfront and D365\) to reflect changes in portfolio, billability, reporting structure, employment status, and more.
* Manage the employee data onboarding for all new hires, including the creation and configuration of employee records with all necessary information such as start dates, team assignments, and role\-specific details.
* Create and manage D365 roles and team codes within our systems, including the assignment of cost and sales pricing for all rate cards.
* Assign appropriate roles and team codes to all employees to ensure accurate data and system functionality.
* Ensure data accuracy and consistency across all platforms by performing regular audits and resolving any discrepancies.
* Manage and respond to data\-related inquiries and change requests submitted through ServiceNow and other official channels.


**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent education plus professional experience) required
* 3\+ years of resource management or relevant agency project management experience
* Proficient with Microsoft Excel
* A positive, problem\-solving attitude
* Organized and detail\-oriented while also strong at multitasking
* Excellent communication skills


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent education plus professional experience) required
* 3\+ years of resource management or relevant agency project management experience
* Proficient with Microsoft Excel
* A positive, problem\-solving attitude
* Organized and detail\-oriented while also strong at multitasking
* Excellent communication skills


**Additional Information**
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e\-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.
   

  

 From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.
   

  

 Follow us on LinkedIn \| Twitter

title: Associate Director, Global HR Operations (Bangkok Based -Relocation provided)
description:
**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The People Team at Agoda is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional talent from across the globe. We work to create an inclusive, high\-performing, and engaging environment where employees can grow, contribute meaningfully, and do their best work. Through a strong focus on people experience, service quality, and business partnership, we help Agoda scale while preserving what makes our culture distinctive.
   

  

 Within the People Team, the
 **People Experience and Services** 
 function is responsible for designing and delivering critical people experiences, services, and operating foundations that support employees and managers across the employee lifecycle. This includes enabling smooth onboarding and mobility experiences, delivering effective workplace and office services, and ensuring employees have access to timely, trusted, and high\-quality support when they need it.
   

  

 At the center of this model sits
 **People Services \& Help Desk** 
 — Agoda’s front door for People support — supported by specialist service teams such as
 **People Relations Services** 
 . Together, these teams play a critical role in how employees and managers experience the People function day to day: through clear guidance, responsive support, effective issue resolution, and trusted handling of sensitive people matters.
   

  

**Opportunity**
 We are looking for an
 **Associate Director, Head of People Services \& Help Desk** 
 to lead Agoda’s employee\-facing People service delivery model across
 **People Help Desk / Tier 1 support** 
 ,
 **Tier 0 / self\-service foundations** 
 , and
 **Global People Relations Services** 
 .
   

  

 This is a key leadership role within People Experience and Services, responsible for shaping how employees and managers access support across a wide range of People topics — from day\-to\-day HR questions and lifecycle support to more complex and sensitive employee matters requiring specialist intervention.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead the teams responsible for:
   

  

* People Help Desk / Tier 1 services
* Tier 0 / self\-service and knowledge foundations
* Global People Relations Services, including case governance and specialist support for complex employee relations matters


 You will own the effectiveness of Agoda’s People support model from the employee and manager perspective, ensuring it is clear, trusted, scalable, and increasingly insight\-driven. This includes strengthening service standards, improving routing and handoffs across teams, enabling greater self\-service, and ensuring sensitive employee matters are handled with appropriate quality, consistency, and governance.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a leader who combines strong service delivery and operational leadership with sound judgment, systems thinking, and the ability to build a modern, scalable People support model in a global, fast\-moving organization.
   

  

 This position is based in
 **Bangkok** 
 . Agoda provides relocation support for successful candidates who are not currently located in Bangkok. Please note that we are
 **not open to remote work** 
 or the possibility of being based in other locations.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Lead Agoda’s People Services front door and employee support model**
* Lead Agoda’s employee\-facing People Services model across Tier 1 Help Desk support, Tier 0 self\-service, and the interface into specialist support teams.
* Define and evolve how employees and managers access support across People topics, ensuring a clear, seamless, and trusted experience.
* Establish strong service principles, operating rhythms, and leadership across the teams responsible for day\-to\-day People support and complex employee issue resolution.
* Ensure Agoda’s People support model scales effectively with organizational growth, complexity, and global reach.


**Lead the People Services \& Help Desk team**
* Lead, manage, and develop the People Services \& Help Desk team to deliver high\-quality, consistent, and empathetic Tier 1 support across core HR topics such as policies, processes, employee data, benefits, onboarding, leaves, mobility, and general employee lifecycle support.
* Set service standards, KPIs, quality expectations, and operating controls to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant case handling.
* Build a strong service culture with clear accountability for employee experience, right\-first\-time resolution, responsiveness, and professionalism.
* Oversee workforce planning, capacity management, and prioritization across service demand, seasonal peaks, and new People initiatives.


**Lead Global People Relations Services**
* Lead the Global People Relations Services team, ensuring high\-quality and well\-governed support across complex employee matters such as performance concerns, misconduct, grievances, investigations, disciplinary actions, involuntary exits, and employee matters arising from organizational change.
* Ensure clear service ownership, escalation pathways, and governance across People Relations case handling.
* Partner closely with HR Business Partners, Legal, Compliance, and other relevant stakeholders to ensure people relations matters are handled fairly, consistently, pragmatically, and in line with internal policies and local legal requirements.
* Drive high standards in case management, documentation, risk identification, and decision quality across the People Relations team.
* Use case trends and themes to inform improvements in manager guidance, policy design, service processes, and broader practices.


**Own the operating interfaces across Tier 1, People Relations, and specialist teams**
* Serve as the senior operational owner for how work flows between Help Desk / Tier 1, People Relations Services, and other Tier 2 / specialist teams across the People organization.
* Define and continuously improve routing logic, escalation models, intake criteria, handoffs, service ownership, and resolution pathways.
* Ensure employees and managers experience a joined\-up service model even when multiple People teams are involved.
* Clarify roles and interfaces across Help Desk, People Relations, Payroll, Rewards, Mobility, People Partners, CoEs, and other specialist teams.


**Build Tier 0 / self\-service and knowledge management foundations**
* Develop and execute Agoda’s roadmap for Tier 0 / self\-service, moving the organization toward more proactive, intuitive, and self\-directed resolution of common People queries.
* Own and strengthen the People knowledge ecosystem, including FAQs, help content, decision trees, agent guidance, and employee\-facing support materials.
* Partner with policy owners and People SMEs to simplify complex topics into clear, scalable, and user\-friendly content.
* Drive case deflection, knowledge reuse, content governance, and self\-service adoption through disciplined measurement and continuous improvement.


**Enable digital, conversational, and AI\-supported service delivery**
* Partner with Product, Tech, Systems, and Data teams to improve People support platforms, workflows, and user journeys across self\-service and case management.
* Identify and help shape practical use cases for conversational and agentic AI within People Services, ensuring they enhance employee experience and complement human support.
* Provide leadership input into the design, testing, rollout, and continuous refinement of AI\-enabled and digital service solutions.
* Ensure appropriate controls, privacy, escalation paths, and trust mechanisms are in place for all digital and AI\-supported support channels.


**Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement**
* Monitor and improve key service performance metrics across Help Desk and People Relations Services, such as case volume, first contact resolution, time to resolution, service quality, customer satisfaction, escalation rates, re\-open rates, and self\-service deflection.
* Lead ongoing improvements in workflows, playbooks, standard responses, training, quality assurance, and reporting.
* Partner with People Service Excellence and other stakeholders to simplify processes, remove friction, and improve end\-to\-end employee and manager experiences.
* Ensure effective controls, compliance, documentation standards, and data privacy practices are embedded across service operations.


**Lead through insight, stakeholder partnership, and change**
* Act as the senior People Services contact for service performance, priorities, risks, and transformation opportunities.
* Provide regular insight and reporting to People leaders on service trends, root causes, organizational pain points, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with Communications and relevant People teams to coordinate messaging around policy changes, process updates, and new tools or services.
* Support broader People transformation by bringing an employee\-service lens to operating model design, simplification, and capability building across the function.


**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Human Resources, Operations, Law, Psychology, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.
* Typically, 10\+ years of relevant experience across HR shared services, employee services, People operations, employee relations, HRBP, service delivery, or related functions, including significant leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading managers and/or multiple service teams in a complex, matrixed, and fast\-paced environment.
* Strong experience running a service or support function with clear accountability for quality, responsiveness, service design, and stakeholder experience.
* Strong understanding of multi\-tier service delivery models, including Tier 0 / self\-service, Tier 1 support, and specialist / Tier 2 case management.
* Meaningful exposure to employee relations or complex people issue resolution, with sound judgment on sensitive matters and a strong appreciation for governance, risk, and consistency.
* Strong skills in service design, operating model improvement, process improvement, and cross\-functional workflow design.
* Experience with HR technology platforms and service tools such as HRIS, case management systems, knowledge bases, and digital support tools.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and analytics to monitor performance, identify themes and root causes, and drive prioritization and decision\-making.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and influence across leaders, specialist teams, and cross\-functional partners.
* Strong people leadership capability, including coaching leaders and managers, building team capability, and creating a high\-performance, service\-oriented culture.
* Comfort operating in a global, evolving, and ambiguous environment, with a strong bias for execution, improvement, and scale.


**It’s great if you also have**
* Experience in a global or regional HR shared services / People services environment.
* Experience leading both broad employee support teams and specialist employee relations or case management teams.
* Experience in knowledge management, service content strategy, and self\-service adoption.
* Hands\-on exposure to conversational AI, chatbots, virtual assistants, or workflow automation in HR or customer support environments.
* Experience improving employee experience through service redesign, process simplification, or digital product thinking.
* Experience in a high\-growth tech, internet, or digital business.
* Familiarity with global organizations operating across multiple countries, cultures, and regulatory environments.


**Why this role matters**
 This role is a unique opportunity to shape how Agoda employees and managers experience People support at scale. From everyday HR queries to more complex and sensitive employee matters, the teams in this scope play an important role in making sure our people feel supported, informed, and able to navigate key moments in their Agoda journey with confidence.
   

  

 As
 **Associate Director, Head of People Services \& Help Desk**
